Lessons.Title: The Hyperbola
ExplanationParagraphs: Hyperbola consists of two branches with constant difference of focal distances.
Focal distance c²=a²+b² and asymptotes y−k=±(b/a)(x−h).
Complete squares to recover standard form and identify vertices/foci.
Cooling tower hyperbolic cross-sections and orbital paths can be approximated with asymptotes.
Independent Cool-down: identify the standard conic, state relevant foci/axis features, and verify the equation with an independent point.
